transfer_checks: Recompute answer volume after changing query radius or feedback.
Exact gradients destroy the construction: one exact gradient points to the center.

construction.definition: Place n=exp(Theta(r)) centers on the radius-r circle with separation at least r/2. Draw x* uniformly and set f_{x*}(x)=d(x,x*)^2.
construction.model_membership_refs: Squared distance is smooth and strongly geodesically convex; on a ball of radius O(r), its smoothness scales O(r), with constants depending on normalization of the squared distance.
construction.parameters: See definition and context_scope for the complete parameter and dimension dependencies; do not omit them elsewhere.
construction.public_information: r, metric, candidate packing, query bound and noise model

context_scope.GUARANTEE: uniform prior on packing; target success >=2/3
context_scope.METRIC: probability of identifying the packing center
context_scope.MODEL: H^2 of curvature -1; x* lies on radius-r circle; choose an exp(Theta(r))-point packing with pairwise distances >=r/2; f_{x*}(x)=d(x,x*)^2
context_scope.ORACLE: independent additive noise in value and tangent gradient; queries restricted to B(o,1000r); joint noise density bounded by c and magnitude by C
context_scope.TASK: locate x* in hyperbolic plane to distance r/5

escape_conditions.epistemic_note: Applicability restrictions recorded by the extractor, awaiting independent verification.
escape_conditions.statement: With exact gradient information, x* is recovered in one query. This family does not support an exact-oracle lower bound.

oracle_realizations.choices_and_history: arbitrary noisy-query strategies; see information_bottleneck for the precise adaptivity restrictions.
oracle_realizations.information_bottleneck: Within the bounded query region the answers lie in a finite-volume Euclidean value/tangent-gradient region; apply the density-limited query game.
oracle_realizations.information_to_error: Balls of radius r/5 around packing centers are disjoint; such localization identifies the hidden index.
oracle_realizations.query_and_feedback: Return f(x)+z_1 and grad f(x)+z_2, independent across queries, with common joint density cap and bounded support; query region B(o,1000r).
oracle_realizations.sampling_and_reuse: Use the interface specified by query_and_feedback; other noise models or couplings not established there are outside the scope.
